relationships.subject: SAF312
relationships.evidence_quote: A new study by Fanet al."Structural basis of TRPV1 inhibition by SAF312 and cholesterol" sheds new light on the mechanistic structural basis of TRPV1 inhibition by SAF312 (Libvatrep), a TRPV1 antagonist, currently in phase II clinical trials.

relationships.subject: cholesterol
relationships.evidence_quote: removal of cholesterol interferes with the ability of SAF312 to suppress TRPV1 current

key_findings: The SAF312 binding site in TRPV1 is near and partially overlaps the cholesterol binding site.
Cholesterol removal impairs SAF312 suppression of TRPV1 current.
